title: Van der Waerden number W(4,4), lower bound
statement: Colour n consecutive integers with 4 colours so that no colour holds an arithmetic progression of 4 terms, with n as large as possible; it shows W(4,4) > n. The best known lower bound is W(4,4) >= 1049, by Rabung and Lotts (2012), so such a colouring of 1048 integers is known and one of 1049 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the colours of the n integers in order, digits 0..3 (whitespace ignored).
score: n, the number of integers coloured; it proves W(4,4) >= n + 1 (larger is better)

best_known.source: W(4,4) >= 1049: Rabung and Lotts (2012), in Leaps in Bounds (github.com/daniel-munro/leaps-in-bounds), data at commit 4521e13 (8 Nov 2026); read 8 Nov 2026
